data.name: Arnav
data.long_meaning: Arnav is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'arnava', which means 'movement', 'flow', or 'progress'. In Hindu mythology, Arnav is the name of a god who is believed to represent the cosmic flow of energy, or Prana Shakti. The name carries a deep spiritual significance, symbolizing the continuous flow of life and the progression of the soul towards enlightenment.
